incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high 5xx rate in inference-prod (route: /v1/generate). Severity: P1. Pager routed to #eng-oncall and paging oncall primary.

maria (oncall): grabbing this. I'm at handoff now — primary for the next 30m. Anyone on secondary?

jonah: i'm secondary for this shift, jumping in. quick question — is this global or region-specific?

incident-bot: Alert details: 5xx spike at 12:42 UTC, affected hosts: gpu-pool-03/*, error sig: kv-cache-miss-exceeded-threshold.

maria (oncall): looks like it's concentrated on gpu-pool-03 in us-west1 from the initial graph. severity seems to affect streaming gen calls (customers A and B seeing timeouts).

leo: i'm around for 15 more mins, can take comms until handoff completes.

maria (oncall): ok assigning roles: i'll be incident driver (investigate/mitigate). @leo you'll be comms owner (customer updates + #status). @jonah you're secondary — focus on tracing KV cache pressure and fallback routing. @sara/anya ping if you can take over after 15m to cover gaps.

sara: can take over if needed, 20m til meeting then free.

anya: I can jump in after 25m, will stand by.

jonah: noted. first action: check runtime metrics and fallback logs. Runbook section: "Inference: KV cache pressure & degraded streaming" — see quick check below:

```
# check recent errors on pool
gcloud logging read "resource.labels.cluster_name=\"inference-prod\" AND labels.pool=\"gpu-pool-03\" AND severity>=ERROR" --limit 50
```

maria (oncall): thanks. jonah, if you confirm KV cache churn, enable temporary routing to gpu-pool-04 and scale burst for pool-03. I'll open a canary fallback policy.

jonah: running checks now. I see rapid evictions in kv_cache for nginx-proxy on those hosts, heap pressure rising. Tentatively flipping fallback routing to pool-04 (will post command).

leo: posting short customer note template for status page and slack thread: "We're investigating increased 5xx rates for generation API in us-west1. Traffic may be routed to alternate capacity. No data loss. We'll update in 15m or as we have mitigation." Use that? :eyes:

maria (oncall): yep use that. leo, once you post, include staging link for the mitigation plan and who's the primary/comm.

leo: posted to #status and pinged accounts team.

jonah: executed routing change: `rb rroute apply --from=gpu-pool-03 --to=gpu-pool-04 --selector="route=/v1/generate" --temp 30m` — traffic now shifting. Observability shows 5xx rate dropping on gpu-pool-03 and increasing latency slightly on pool-04.

maria (oncall): good. next: check customer impact. Which customers hit error budget? any critical SLAs?

jonah: customers A and B saw uptick in client-side retries; error budget for B is at 82% this hour (threshold 90%). Not yet breach but trending.

maria (oncall): leo, add note to the customer update: potential short degradation, mitigation in progress, no SLA breach yet, will follow up in 30m or earlier.

leo: done. added comms owner tag: maria (driver), leo (comms), jonah (secondary).

sara: quick runbook pointer: if fallback doesn't reduce errors in 10m, try restarting nginx-proxy on affected hosts with grace: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/nginx-proxy -n inference --selector=pool=gpu-pool-03`

maria (oncall): good call. jonah, can you coordinate that if needed. Also we need to log incident in PagerDuty + create an incident doc (I'll start draft).

jonah: will hold on restart until traffic is stable post-routing. monitoring shows error count down 40% in last 3m.

anya: taking over primary in 20m if things stable?
